meta.title: Smart provider
meta.description: Meta-provider that fails over across configured provider routes with establishment-only fallback, hop-level cooldown, per-hop session records, offline cost meter and account ranking. A dedicated settings section offers overview / routing / cost & health.

setting.title: Smart provider
setting.description: Configure chains, account pool, ranking strategy and cost health; all edits apply live without a restart.

costPill.cardHelp: Turn it on, then look beside the input box in the conversation for the estimate. Clearing statistics only resets the start marker; the full ledger is kept. No restart needed.
costPill.enabledHelp: Off by default; once checked, look beside the conversation input for the accumulated estimate (position below).
costPill.positionHelp: Conversation slot for the pill; compact input-right by default.
costPill.refreshMsHelp: Default 60000 ms; enter 0 to disable auto-refresh. Manual refresh stays available. Valid minimum 1000 ms.
costPill.clearConfirm: This only sets a new start marker; the cost ledger is never deleted. Continue?
costPill.clearNote: This only resets the display start marker. The full ledger is kept and health evidence is unaffected.
costPill.error: Statistics could not be read or updated. Please retry shortly.
